verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online directly documents bank/credit card/PayPal/Square connections with automatic transaction import and reconciliation, invoice payments auto-matched to the ledger, and payroll AI that pulls time/attendance data into payroll runs, plus 800+ app integrations covering payments and banking ecosystems. Community evidence corroborates rule-based bank transaction categorization actually working in practice. Missing for 10: no independent verification specifically of payroll-to-ledger automation reliability, and general community complaints about reliability/quality introduce some caveats.
